158 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLISensorStart (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
159 {
160  bool doReconfig = true;
161  int32_t retVal = 0;
162 
163  /* Only following command syntax will be supported
164  sensorStart
165  sensorStart 0
166  */
167  if (argc == 2)
168  {
169  doReconfig = (bool) atoi (argv[1]);
170 
171  if (doReconfig == true)
172  {
173  CLI_write ("Error: Reconfig is not supported, only argument of 0 is\n"
174  "(do not reconfig, just re-start the sensor) valid\n");
175  return -1;
176  }
177  }
178  else
179  {
180  /* In case there is no argument for sensorStart, always do reconfig */
181  doReconfig = true;
182  }
183 
184  /***********************************************************************************
185  * Spread SPectrum Configuration
186  ***********************************************************************************/
187  MMWDemo_configSSC();
188 
189  /***********************************************************************************
190  * Do sensor state management to influence the sensor actions
191  ***********************************************************************************/
192 
193  /* Error checking initial state: no partial config is allowed
194  until the first sucessful sensor start state */
195  if ((gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_INIT) ||
196  (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_OPENED))
197  {
198  MMWave_CtrlCfg ctrlCfg;
199 
200  /* need to get number of sub-frames so that next function to check
201  * pending state can work */
202  CLI_getMMWaveExtensionConfig (&ctrlCfg);
203  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames =
204  MmwDemo_RFParser_getNumSubFrames(&ctrlCfg);
205 
206 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
207  if (MmwDemo_isAllCfgInPendingState() == 0)
208  {
209  CLI_write ("Error: Full configuration must be provided before sensor can be started "
210  "the first time\n");
211 
212  /* Although not strictly needed, bring back to the initial value since we
213  * are rejecting this first time configuration, prevents misleading debug. */
214  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames = 0;
215 
216  return -1;
217  }
218 #endif
219  }
220 
221  if (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_STARTED)
222  {
223  CLI_write ("Ignored: Sensor is already started\n");
224  return 0;
225  }
226 
227  if (doReconfig == false)
228  {
229 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
230  /* User intends to issue sensor start without config, check if no
231  config was issued after stop and generate error if this is the case. */
232  if (MmwDemo_isAllCfgInNonPendingState() == 0)
233  {
234  /* Message user differently if all config was issued or partial config was
235  issued. */
236  if (MmwDemo_isAllCfgInPendingState())
237  {
238  CLI_write ("Error: You have provided complete new configuration, "
239  "issue \"sensorStart\" (without argument) if you want it to "
240  "take effect\n");
241  }
242  else
243  {
244  CLI_write ("Error: You have provided partial configuration between stop and this "
245  "command and partial configuration cannot be undone."
246  "Issue the full configuration and do \"sensorStart\" \n");
247  }
248  return -1;
249  }
250 #endif
251  }
252  else
253  {
254  /* User intends to issue sensor start with full config, check if all config
255  was issued after stop and generate error if is the case. */
256  MMWave_CtrlCfg ctrlCfg;
257 
258  /* need to get number of sub-frames so that next function to check
259  * pending state can work */
260  CLI_getMMWaveExtensionConfig (&ctrlCfg);
261  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames =
262  MmwDemo_RFParser_getNumSubFrames(&ctrlCfg);
263 
264 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
265  if (MmwDemo_isAllCfgInPendingState() == 0)
266  {
267  /* Message user differently if no config was issued or partial config was
268  issued. */
269  if (MmwDemo_isAllCfgInNonPendingState())
270  {
271  CLI_write ("Error: You have provided no configuration, "
272  "issue \"sensorStart 0\" OR provide "
273  "full configuration and issue \"sensorStart\"\n");
274  }
275  else
276  {
277  CLI_write ("Error: You have provided partial configuration between stop and this "
278  "command and partial configuration cannot be undone."
279  "Issue the full configuration and do \"sensorStart\" \n");
280  }
281  /* Although not strictly needed, bring back to the initial value since we
282  * are rejecting this first time configuration, prevents misleading debug. */
283  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames = 0;
284  return -1;
285  }
286 #endif
287  }

289  /***********************************************************************************
290  * Retreive and check mmwave Open related config before calling openSensor
291  ***********************************************************************************/
292 
293  /* Fill demo's MCB mmWave openCfg structure from the CLI configs*/
294  if (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_INIT)
295  {
296  /* Get the open configuration: */
297  CLI_getMMWaveExtensionOpenConfig (&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg);
298  /* call sensor open */
299  retVal = MmwDemo_openSensor(true);
300  if(retVal != 0)
301  {
302  return -1;
303  }
304  gMmwMssMCB.sensorState = MmwDemo_SensorState_OPENED;
305  }
306  else
307  {
308  /* openCfg related configurations like chCfg, lowPowerMode, adcCfg
309  * are only used on the first sensor start. If they are different
310  * on a subsequent sensor start, then generate a fatal error
311  * so the user does not think that the new (changed) configuration
312  * takes effect, the board needs to be reboot for the new
313  * configuration to be applied.
314  */
315  MMWave_OpenCfg openCfg;
316  CLI_getMMWaveExtensionOpenConfig (&openCfg);
317  /* Compare openCfg->chCfg*/
318  if(memcmp((void *)&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.chCfg, (void *)&openCfg.chCfg,
319  sizeof(rlChanCfg_t)) != 0)
320  {
321  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
322  }
323 
324  /* Compare openCfg->lowPowerMode*/
325  if(memcmp((void *)&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.lowPowerMode, (void *)&openCfg.lowPowerMode,
326  sizeof(rlLowPowerModeCfg_t)) != 0)
327  {
328  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
329  }
330  /* Compare openCfg->adcOutCfg*/
331  if(memcmp((void *)&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.adcOutCfg, (void *)&openCfg.adcOutCfg,
332  sizeof(rlAdcOutCfg_t)) != 0)
333  {
334  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
335  }
336  }
337 
338 
339 
340  /***********************************************************************************
341  * Retrieve mmwave Control related config before calling startSensor
342  ***********************************************************************************/
343  /* Get the mmWave ctrlCfg from the CLI mmWave Extension */
344  if(doReconfig)
345  {
346  /* if MmwDemo_openSensor has non-first time related processing, call here again*/
347  /* call sensor config */
348  CLI_getMMWaveExtensionConfig (&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg);
349  retVal = MmwDemo_configSensor();
350  if(retVal != 0)
351  {
352  return -1;
353  }
354  }
355  retVal = MmwDemo_startSensor();
356  if(retVal != 0)
357  {
358  return -1;
359  }
360 
361  /***********************************************************************************
362  * Set the state
363  ***********************************************************************************/
364  gMmwMssMCB.sensorState = MmwDemo_SensorState_STARTED;
365  return 0;
366 }

383 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLISensorStop (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
384 {
385  if ((gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_STOPPED) ||
386  (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_INIT) ||
387  (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_OPENED))
388  {
389  CLI_write ("Ignored: Sensor is already stopped\n");
390  return 0;

392 
393  MmwDemo_stopSensor();
394 
395 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
396  MmwDemo_resetStaticCfgPendingState();
397 #endif
398 
399  gMmwMssMCB.sensorState = MmwDemo_SensorState_STOPPED;
400  return 0;
401 }

418 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIGetSubframe (int32_t argc, char* argv[], int32_t expectedArgc,
419  int8_t* subFrameNum)
420 {
421  int8_t subframe;
422 
423  /* Sanity Check: Minimum argument check */
424  if (argc != expectedArgc)
425  {
426  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command\n");
427  return -1;
428  }
429 
430  /*Subframe info is always in position 1*/
431  subframe = (int8_t) atoi(argv[1]);
432 
433  if(subframe >= (int8_t)RL_MAX_SUBFRAMES)
434  {
435  CLI_write ("Error: Subframe number is invalid\n");
436  return -1;
437  }
438 
439  *subFrameNum = (int8_t)subframe;
440 
441  return 0;
442 }

551 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLICfarCfg (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
552 {
553  DPU_CFARProc_CfarCfg cfarCfg;
554  uint32_t procDirection;
555  int8_t subFrameNum;
556  float threshold;
557 
558  if(MmwDemo_CLIGetSubframe(argc, argv, 10, &subFrameNum) < 0)
559  {
560  return -1;
561  }
562 
563  /* Initialize configuration: */
564  memset ((void *)&cfarCfg, 0, sizeof(cfarCfg));
565 
566  /* Populate configuration: */
567  procDirection = (uint32_t) atoi (argv[2]);
568  cfarCfg.averageMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[3]);
569  cfarCfg.winLen = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[4]);
570  cfarCfg.guardLen = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[5]);
571  cfarCfg.noiseDivShift = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[6]);
572  cfarCfg.cyclicMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[7]);
573  threshold = (float) atof (argv[8]);
574  cfarCfg.peakGroupingEn = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[9]);
575 
576  if (threshold > 100.0)
577  {
578  CLI_write("Error: Maximum value for CFAR thresholdScale is 100.0 dB.\n");
579  return -1;
580  }
581 
582  /* threshold is a float value from 0-100dB. It needs to
583  be later converted to linear scale (conversion can only be done
584  when the number of virtual antennas is known) before passing it
585  to CFAR DPU.
586  For now, the threshold will be coded in a 16bit integer in the following
587  way:
588  suppose threshold is a float represented as XYZ.ABC
589  it will be saved as a 16bit integer XYZAB
590  that is, 2 decimal cases are saved.*/
591  threshold = threshold * MMWDEMO_CFAR_THRESHOLD_ENCODING_FACTOR;
592  cfarCfg.thresholdScale = (uint16_t) threshold;
593 
594  /* Save Configuration to use later */
595  if (procDirection == 0)
596  {
597  MmwDemo_CfgUpdate((void *)&cfarCfg, MMWDEMO_CFARCFGRANGE_OFFSET,
598  sizeof(cfarCfg), subFrameNum);
599  }
600  else
601  {
602  MmwDemo_CfgUpdate((void *)&cfarCfg, MMWDEMO_CFARCFGDOPPLER_OFFSET,
603  sizeof(cfarCfg), subFrameNum);
604  }
605  return 0;
606 }
607 #endif
608

625 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLICfarCfg (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
626 {
627  uint32_t procDirection;
628  int8_t subFrameNum;
629  float threshold;
630 
631  if(argc < 9)
632  {
633  return -1;
634  }
635  procDirection = (uint32_t) atoi (argv[2]);
636  threshold = (float) atof (argv[8]);
637 
638  if (threshold > 100.0)
639  {
640  CLI_write("Error: Maximum value for CFAR thresholdScale is 100.0 dB.\n");
641  return -1;
642  }
643 
644  /* threshold is a float value from 0-100dB. It needs to
645  be later converted to linear scale (conversion can only be done
646  when the number of virtual antennas is known) before passing it
647  to CFAR DPU.
648  For now, the threshold will be coded in a 16bit integer in the following
649  way:
650  suppose threshold is a float represented as XYZ.ABC
651  it will be saved as a 16bit integer XYZAB
652  that is, 2 decimal cases are saved.*/
653  threshold = threshold * MMWDEMO_CFAR_THRESHOLD_ENCODING_FACTOR;
654 
655  /* Save Configuration to use later */
656  if (procDirection == 0)
657  {
658  DPU_CFARProc_CfarCfg cfarCfg;
659 
660  if(MmwDemo_CLIGetSubframe(argc, argv, 13, &subFrameNum) < 0)

668  cfarCfg.noiseDivShift = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[6]);
669  cfarCfg.cyclicMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[7]);
670  cfarCfg.thresholdScale = (uint16_t) threshold;
671  cfarCfg.peakGroupingEn = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[9]);
672  cfarCfg.osKvalue = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[10]);
673  cfarCfg.osEdgeKscaleEn = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[11]);
674  cfarCfg.isEnabled = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[12]);
675  MmwDemo_CfgUpdate((void *)&cfarCfg, MMWDEMO_CFARCFGRANGE_OFFSET,
676  sizeof(cfarCfg), subFrameNum);
677  }
678  else
679  {
680  DPU_DopplerProc_CfarCfg cfarCfg;
681 
682  if(MmwDemo_CLIGetSubframe(argc, argv, 14, &subFrameNum) < 0)
683  {
684  return -1;
685  }
686  /* Initialize configuration: */
687  memset ((void *)&cfarCfg, 0, sizeof(cfarCfg));
688  /* Populate configuration: */
689  cfarCfg.averageMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[3]);
690  cfarCfg.winLen = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[4]);
691  cfarCfg.guardLen = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[5]);
692  cfarCfg.noiseDivShift = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[6]);
693  cfarCfg.cyclicMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[7]);
694  cfarCfg.thresholdScale = (uint16_t) threshold;
695  cfarCfg.peakGroupingEn = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[9]);
696  cfarCfg.osKvalue = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[10]);
697  cfarCfg.osEdgeKscaleEn = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[11]);
698  cfarCfg.isEnabled = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[12]);
699  cfarCfg.variableThresholdMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[13]);
700  if(cfarCfg.isEnabled == 0){
701  CLI_write("Error: Doppler CFAR Cannot be disabled.\n");

704  sizeof(cfarCfg), subFrameNum);
705  }

934 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIAntGeometryCfg (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
935 {
937  uint32_t i=0, azimElemIdx=0, elevElemIdx = 0;
938  uint64_t zeroInsrtMaskAzim = 0, zeroInsrtMaskElev = 0;
939  Element antArr[MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT];
940  Element *elevAntArr = &antArr[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT];
941 
942  /* Sanity Check: Minimum argument check */
943  if (argc < (1 + MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT*2 + 2))
944  {
945  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command\n");
946  return -1;
947  }
948 
949  /* Assumption: row1: azimuth antenna array, row0: elevation antenna array */
950  for (i = 1; i < MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT * 2 + 1; i+=2) {
951  if(atoi(argv[i]) == 0)
952  {
953  /* Elevation Antenna Sample */
954  antArr[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT + elevElemIdx].value = atoi(argv[i+1]);
955  antArr[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT + elevElemIdx].index = elevElemIdx;
956  elevElemIdx++;
957  }
958  else if(atoi(argv[i]) == 1)
959  {
960  /* Azimuth Antenna Sample */
961  antArr[azimElemIdx].value = atoi(argv[i+1]);
962  antArr[azimElemIdx].index = azimElemIdx;
963  azimElemIdx++;
964  }
965  else
966  {
967  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command. Assumption - Row1: Azimuth Array (12 elements), Row0: Elevation Array (4 elements) \n");
968  return -1;
969  }
970  }
971 
972  /* Sort the azimuth array of structures based on value */
973  qsort(antArr, MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT, sizeof(antArr[0]), compare);
974 
975  /* Sort the elevation array of structures based on value */
976  qsort(elevAntArr, MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT, sizeof(elevAntArr[0]), compare);
977 
978  /* Store the rearrangement Order */
979  for (i = 0; i < MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT; i++)
980  {
981  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.antennaGeometryCfg[i] = (uint16_t) antArr[i].index;
982  }
983 
984  /* Find the zero insertion mask */
985  for(i=0; i < MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT; i++)
986  {
987  zeroInsrtMaskAzim |= (uint64_t)1 << antArr[i].value;
988  }
989  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskAzim = zeroInsrtMaskAzim;
990  /* Check the number of set bits in azimuth array zero insertion mask */
991  if(mathUtils_countSetBits(gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskAzim) != MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT)
992  {
993  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid input. Azimuth Zero Insertion Mask is incorrect. \n");
994  return -1;
995  }
996 
997  for(i=0; i<MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT; i++)
998  {
999  zeroInsrtMaskElev |= (uint64_t)1 << elevAntArr[i].value;
1000  }
1001  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev = zeroInsrtMaskElev;
1002  /* Check the number of set bits in elevation array zero insertion mask */
1003  if(mathUtils_countSetBits(gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev) != MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT)
1004  {
1005  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid input. Elevation Zero Insertion Mask is incorrect. \n");
1006  return -1;
1007  }
1008 
1009  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.antennaSpacing.xSpacingByLambda = \
1010  atof(argv[MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT * 2 + 1]);
1011  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.antennaSpacing.zSpacingByLambda = \
1012  atof(argv[MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT * 2 + 2]);
1013 
1014  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.isAntennaGeometryCfgPending = 1;
1015 
1016  return 0;
1017 }
1018

1038  float antennaCalibParams[SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL * SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS * 2];

1078  return 0;

1684 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLILvdsStreamCfg (int32_t argc, char* argv[])

1689  if (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_STARTED)

1692  return 0;
1693  }
1694 
1695  if(MmwDemo_CLIGetSubframe(argc, argv, 5, &subFrameNum) < 0)
1696  {
1697  return -1;
1698  }
1699 
1700  /* Initialize configuration for DC range signature calibration */
1701  memset ((void *)&cfg, 0, sizeof(MmwDemo_LvdsStreamCfg));
1702 
1703  /* Populate configuration: */
1704  cfg.isHeaderEnabled = (bool) atoi(argv[2]);
1705  cfg.dataFmt = (uint8_t) atoi(argv[3]);
1706  cfg.isSwEnabled = (bool) atoi(argv[4]);
1707 
1708  /* If both h/w and s/w are enabled, HSI header must be enabled, because
1709  * we don't allow mixed h/w session without HSI header
1710  * simultaneously with s/w session with HSI header (s/w session always
1711  * streams HSI header) */
1712  if ((cfg.isSwEnabled == true) && (cfg.dataFmt != MMW_DEMO_LVDS_STREAM_CFG_DATAFMT_DISABLED))
1713  {
1714  if (cfg.isHeaderEnabled == false)
1715  {
1716  CLI_write("Error: header must be enabled when both h/w and s/w streaming are enabled\n");
1717  return -1;
1718  }
1719  }
1720 
1721  /* Save Configuration to use later */
1722  MmwDemo_CfgUpdate((void *)&cfg,
1723  MMWDEMO_LVDSSTREAMCFG_OFFSET,
1724  sizeof(MmwDemo_LvdsStreamCfg), subFrameNum);
1725 
1726  return 0;
1727 }

1746 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIConfigDataPort (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
1747 {
1748  uint32_t baudrate;
1749  bool ackPing;
1750  uint8_t ackData[16];
1751  UART_Transaction trans;
1752 
1753  UART_Transaction_init(&trans);
1754 
1755  trans.buf = &ackData[0U];
1756  trans.count = sizeof(ackData);
1757 
1758  if (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_STARTED)
1759  {
1760  CLI_write ("Ignored: This command is not allowed after sensor has started\n");
1761  return 0;
1762  }
1763 
1764  /* Populate configuration: */
1765  baudrate = (uint32_t) atoi(argv[1]);
1766  ackPing = (bool) atoi(argv[2]);
1767 
1768  /* check if requested value is less than max supported value */
1769  if (baudrate > MMWDEMO_DATAUART_MAX_BAUDRATE_SUPPORTED)
1770  {
1771  CLI_write ("Ignored: Invalid baud rate (%d) specified\n",baudrate);
1772  return 0;
1773  }
1774 
1775  UART_close(gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1]);
1776  gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1] = NULL;
1777 
1778  gUartParams[CONFIG_UART1].baudRate = (uint32_t) atoi(argv[1]);
1779 
1780  gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1] = UART_open(CONFIG_UART1, &gUartParams[CONFIG_UART1]);
1781  if(NULL == gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1])
1782  {
1783  DebugP_logError("UART open failed for instance %d !!!\r\n", CONFIG_UART1);
1784  return 0;
1785  }
1786 
1787  gMmwMssMCB.loggingUartHandle = gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1];
1788 
1789  /* regardless of baud rate update, ack back to the host over this UART
1790  port if handle is valid and user has requested the ack back */
1791  if ((gMmwMssMCB.loggingUartHandle != NULL) && (ackPing == true))
1792  {
1793  memset(ackData,0xFF,sizeof(ackData));
1794  UART_write(gMmwMssMCB.loggingUartHandle, &trans);
1795  }
1796 
1797  return 0;
1798 }
